...THIRD INNINGS...

What to talk about Ireland! They already are feeling tired but have a big job in their hand. First, an hour to bat and hope not to lose any wickets. They are done and dusted with the ball and were beaten all apart. The scoreboard tells the story. This is still a very good pitch to bat on but will the pressure and tiredness come into play for Ireland? We will find out soon.

Sri Lanka have shown why they dominate so much in their home surface. They have turned the tide and have given themselves a chance to win the game from here. It felt like Sri Lanka were passing the baton to one batter after the other. Everyone came, scored a century or double-century and walked off. First, a big opening standing stand of 228 with the skipper scoring a century. Then Kusal Mendis added 268 along with Nishan Madushka as both scored a double-ton. Dinesh Chandimal was looking good but he got retired out but the baton was in safe hands of Angelo Mathews who ended the innings with a century.

Sri Lanka have declared after scoring a mammoth total of 704! Wow!  A batting masterclass from the home team and they have a lead of 212 on the cards. Angelo Mathews runs back to a standing ovation.  The batters have done the job for the hosts. Around an hour plays left, time for the Lankan bowlers to jump in.
Century for Mathews! And Sri Lanka have declared with a lead of 212. They were waiting for this moment. Fuller and outside off. Mathews drives it through covers for a couple.

Commentary.Commentary: Time for the action to begin! The Irish players walk out to the middle and so do Mendis and Madushka who will resume their innings. Curtis Campher to begin.

It was bat which yet again dominated on Day 3 as the hosts scored freely. They looked well on course to take a lead on Day 3 itself had rain not intervened. FOr now a draw seems the most likelier result but if the rain stays away and Lanka manage to bat as they are doing, we might just get enough time to squeeze in a result. Ireland's chances of winning this game is quite difficult. They will need to get the 9 wickets as quickly as possible if they need to have a chance. Till now, it has been a struggle for their bowlers. Can bowl dominate Day 4? Irish will hope so. Stay tuned for the action in a bit.
... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ...

The inevitable has happened, THE DAY HAS BEEN CALLED OFF! The officials feel the conditions are not going to improve and that will be Stumps. The Lankans have fought back brilliantly in the game and can consider themselves slightly ahead. Ireland on the other hand, will know a couple of quick wickets can turn the tide in their favor. For now though the game seems to be heading towards a draw but if we get two full days of cricket, we might just be in for a surprise. Day 4 starts 15 minutes early which means the action kicks off at 0945 IST (0415 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!
Well, it seems like the wait is going to be a lengthy one as the covers are now on and it is raining. All we can do now is hope the rain goes away quickly and we get some action.

Early Tea has been taken and that is another top session for Sri Lanka! They are bossing the game at the moment. The rate at which they are scoring is almost 5 and they have just lost the one wicket. If things continue the way it is going and light does improve, we might just see them go into the lead on Day 3 itself. Ireland have been poor with the ball, they have bowled far too many boundary balls. If we do resume, they need to be a lot more disciplined and build some pressure. Can they do so? We will find out after the break if the conditions improve.
Now then, the light has been offered and the players are going off. Early Tea might be taken. No official word as of now but we will confirm as soon as we get some news.

Just at the stroke of Lunch, Ireland have found the breakthrough. How badly they needed it! They were itching for someone to strike and Curtis Campher has come up with the breakthrough. They were leaking runs and leaking at a very quick rate but this wicket will just give them hope that the floodgates open from hereon. Ireland still have the first innings lead of 264 runs and will hope for a better second session with the ball. It was all going well for Sri Lanka before their skipper fell but still are in a good position. The openers have laid the foundation. Nishan Madushka is batting well and the other batters will look to bat in the same way. Stay tuned for the second session.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set. The players are out in the middle. Dimuth Karunaratne and Nishan Madushka to resume their batting. Andy McBrine to complete his over.

Hello and welcome to Day 3 between Ireland and Sri Lanka. This match has been full of runs till not with the visitors having the upper hand slightly scoring nearly 500 runs. However, in reply Sri Lanka scored some quick runs to end Day 2 without losing any wickets. A lot of batting still to be done for them but Ireland will hope the pitch starts to assist the bowlers so they could get some early wickets. Will they break the opening stand in the first session? We will find out soon. Stay tuned.
...Day 3, Session 1...

Talking about the day, it has been dominated by the batters. We saw tons from Paul Stirling and Curtis Campher which saw Ireland end with something close to 500 but Sri Lanka in their reply have started well. The hosts will hope the openers can continue the good work on Day 3. Ireland on the other hand, will hope the wicket detoriates and their spinners do get some purhcase, An interesting day awaits. Do join us for the action which begins at 0945 IST (0415 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

Well, that will be Stumps! Sri Lanka have begun well with the bat! They had one session to play out and they have done so without losing a wicket. Nishan Madushka rode his luck, played in an aggressive manner and Dimuth Karunaratne has gone along his merry way. The two have got Sri Lanka off to a good start but there is still a long way to go.
Well, the groundsmen have got the covers on in a flash! It is not raining as of now but it is quite dark and the players are making their way off.
